headline: 11 Michigan deals, $169.7M raised — led by BAMF Health Parent, Inc.

top_deals.summary: BAMF Health Parent, Inc., a Grand Rapids-based health care company, filed a $129.6M equity and options/warrants offering under Rule 506(b); $59.7M sold to 12 investors.

top_deals.company: Michigan State University Federal Credit Union
top_deals.summary: Michigan State University Federal Credit Union, an East Lansing-based financial services company, filed a $75M debt offering under Rule 506(b); $75M sold to 41 investors.
BGW Ventures V, LP, an Ann Arbor-based venture capital fund, disclosed a $22.7M raise; $22.7M sold to 12 investors. (Amended filing.)
BAMF Investment Partners, LLC, an Ada-based investment fund, disclosed a $10.2M raise; $10.2M sold to 60 investors.
Atomic Object LLC, a Grand Rapids-based computers company, filed a $2.5M equity offering under Rule 504; $1.2M sold to 30 investors.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $169.7M sold across 6 Form D filings this week, up 761% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was BAMF Health Parent, Inc. (Grand Rapids, Other Health Care) targeting $129.6M. Good question to ask: are founders in health care & life sciences favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
Modular Devices Holdings, LLC disclosed a deal. It was one of 2 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan private funds assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

4 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $34.9M raised so far — led by BGW Ventures V, LP (Venture Capital Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
